scope: Independently authored teaching implementation based on public component roles and documented platform contracts. All component design fields describe this lab, not recovered vendor implementation.

labels.PUBLISHED_BEHAVIOR: Attributed dated vendor statement; no independent runtime replication.
labels.PLATFORM_CONTRACT: Documented API/protocol behavior; not proof of RICOCHET API selection.
labels.OUR_DESIGN: Original lab choice, including all private-to-this-project formats and rule thresholds.
labels.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: Unavailable or outside delivered prototype scope; never reported as a passed real check.

components.design: Collector-scoped process/thread/image observations in a bounded ring; collection events alone are not cheat findings.
components.parity: No private callback inventory, call graph or detection policy authenticated.

components.design: Original versioned fixed-width buffered IOCTL ABI, restricted default ACL and matching JSONL collector.
components.parity: No compatibility with an Activision driver/device/service implied.

components.design: Bounded in-memory sessions, fresh one-use challenges, ordered batches and HMAC-SHA256 envelope validation.
components.parity: Key-possession demonstration only, not TPM, Secure Boot, Azure Attestation or a production RICOCHET protocol.

components.design: SHA-256 comparisons of explicitly selected owned files against a supplied trusted baseline.
components.parity: No live game memory verification, trusted runtime or Activision manifest format.

components.design: Fictional movement, ammo and entitlement checks with server-owned configuration.
components.parity: No real weapon rules, game state, account API or inventory mutation.

components.design: Synthetic distance/AABB visibility filter before client snapshot construction.
components.parity: No COD map geometry or recovered Server Culling implementation.

components.design: HMAC-chained diagnostic records; trusted checkpoint required for prefix-truncation detection.
components.parity: No Replay Investigation Tool, video reconstruction, model or evidence of completeness.
No production service identity, TLS deployment or Activision endpoint.

not_implemented: Authenticated RICOCHET/MW4 private source or compatible game integration
TPM evidence/enrollment and Azure Attestation verification
Current private detection rules or calibrated ML classifiers
Game executable hardening or live memory protection
Live mitigations, inventory mutations or account enforcement
source_availability: Online official Activision research/open-source index and dated vendor publications; Microsoft kernel examples, Azure SDK source and platform docs. No authenticated complete current RICOCHET implementation located in reviewed material. Search absence does not prove worldwide nonexistence.

upstream_code_references.relationship: Windows reference sample; no RICOCHET code identity or private API use established.
Demonstration client code. Sample settings are not an Activision policy or production client.
